scripts.hooks: chmod +x scripts/hooks/* scripts/check-secrets.sh && git config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks && echo "pre-commit hook installed: secrets are checked before every commit"
scripts.gates: cd contracts && rm -f slither.json && (slither . --json slither.json > /dev/null 2>&1 || true) && forge coverage --report lcov --no-match-coverage "(test|script|lib)/" > /dev/null && cd .. && python3 scripts/gates.py natspec && python3 scripts/gates.py coverage && python3 scripts/gates.py slither
scripts.gates:all: python3 scripts/gates.py natspec --all; python3 scripts/gates.py coverage --all; python3 scripts/gates.py slither --all
